intent: Check that the API is running
expected: docs/API.md System: GET /health returns {"status": "ok"} when the API is running.
docs/API.md Basics: the generated OpenAPI document is downloaded at /openapi.json and lists every field, type and status code for the purchase-to-pay API.
reason: Status 200. Document title is P2P Practice API and the path list matches the endpoints in docs/API.md Endpoints.

intent: List vendors and learn the vendor shape, including which are active
expected: docs/API.md Vendors and Seed data: GET /vendors lists all vendors. After a reset there are two: vnd-001 Maple Ridge Supply (active) and vnd-002 Old Quarry Materials (inactive).
reason: Status 200. Both seed vendors are present with the documented ids, names and active flags.

intent: List the SKU catalog and pick two SKUs with their live catalog prices
expected: docs/API.md Catalog and Seed data: GET /skus lists the five SKUs with catalog prices LUM-2X4-8 4.75, PLY-12-4X8 22.40, CEM-30KG 11.90, REB-10MM-6 18.25, SCR-DECK-1LB 9.99.
reason: Status 200. All five seed SKUs, descriptions and prices are present. 22.40 and 11.90 are returned as JSON numbers 22.4 and 11.9.

intent: Create an active vendor with a unique name for the happy path
expected: docs/API.md Vendors: POST /vendors creates a vendor. name is required. active is optional and defaults to true. Returns 201.
reason: Status 201. Returned vendor id vnd-6fdbf5cd, the submitted name, and active true.

intent: Create a draft purchase order with two catalog SKUs for the new vendor
expected: docs/API.md Purchase orders: POST /purchase-orders creates a draft PO and returns 201. Each line shows received_quantity, plus ordered_value, received_value and fully_received. Status starts as draft.
reason: Status 201. PO po-099df33d is draft for vnd-6fdbf5cd. Both lines echo the requested SKUs, quantities and prices with received_quantity 0. ordered_value is 92.3 (10*4.75 + 2*22.4), received_value 0, fully_received false.

expected: docs/API.md Purchase orders and The purchase-to-pay flow: POST /purchase-orders/{poId}/submit moves a draft to submitted. OpenAPI path /purchase-orders/{poId}/submit returns 200.
reason: Status 200. PO po-099df33d status changed from draft to submitted. Quantities and values are unchanged and nothing is received yet.

intent: Receive every ordered unit on the submitted purchase order
expected: docs/API.md Purchase orders and The purchase-to-pay flow: POST /purchase-orders/{poId}/receive records a delivery on a submitted PO. The PO becomes closed when every line is fully received. OpenAPI returns 200.
reason: Status 200. Both lines received_quantity equals ordered quantity (10 and 2). received_value equals ordered_value 92.3, fully_received is true, and status is closed.

intent: Record a vendor invoice for the same SKUs, quantities and prices that were received
expected: docs/API.md Invoices: POST /invoices records a vendor invoice against a PO. Returns 201 with status received, matched false and partial_receipt null.
reason: Status 201. Invoice inv-85107c32 is received for po-099df33d and vendor vnd-6fdbf5cd. Lines match what was received, total_amount is 92.3, matched is false, partial_receipt is null.

intent: Run the 3-way match on the received invoice
expected: docs/API.md Invoices: POST /invoices/{invoiceId}/match runs the 3-way match. When every line is fully received, partial_receipt is false, status is matched, matched is true, and the values agree. OpenAPI returns 200.
reason: Status 200. Invoice is matched, partial_receipt is false, ordered_value, received_value and invoice_total are all 92.3, and the message is 3-way match passed.

intent: Approve the matched invoice and post the ledger entry
expected: docs/API.md Invoices: POST /invoices/{invoiceId}/approve approves a matched invoice, posts a balanced ledger entry (debit 5000 Materials Expense, credit 2000 Accounts Payable) and returns the vendor exposure. OpenAPI returns 200.
reason: Status 200. Invoice is approved. Debit and credit are both 92.3, balanced is true, and vendor_exposure is 92.3.

intent: Read what the business owes the vendor after approval
expected: docs/API.md Vendors and rule vendor_exposure_math: GET /vendors/{vendorId}/exposure returns open_ap_liability equal to the sum of total_amount over that vendor's approved invoices, plus the approved invoice ids.
reason: Status 200. open_ap_liability is 92.3, the approved invoice total, and approved_invoices lists inv-85107c32.
